resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1935 newspaper describes a 60-foot tower (18.3 m), the figure in our record. Three lookout-history pages describe a 50-foot tower built in 1938 (15.2 m). The sources do not say whether the later tower replaced the earlier one, so the record's height is kept as is.

sources.title: Moon Mountain Lookout Site, Former Fire Lookout Sites register
Moon Mountain, Forest Lookouts (quotes The Semi-Weekly Spokesman-Review and The Colville Examiner)

notes_for_editor: Record access 'permission' is not stated by any source read. Sources say the land is administered by the Colville Indian Reservation and the road has no gates, so no access level is set in facts. Height: the record's 18.3 m matches the 1935 60-foot tower; three pages describe a 50-foot tower built in 1938 (15.2 m). firetower.org, firelookout.com and Willhite share much of the same wording, so they may not be three independent sources. No removal year was found; the 'Removed' tag on the Forest Lookouts page has no date, so no removed event is recorded.
